Package arztis.econnector.main.connector

Class TransactionHandler

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
arztis.econnector.main.connector.TransactionHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.Runnable
public final class TransactionHandler
extends java.lang.Thread
Class to handle all transactions, which are transmitted of the information system. This thread exists once per application.

Anna
